title: Unnecessary flushes of memory adresses even when using the editor
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7-beta3, 4.7-beta4 (where I saw this issue)

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta4.mono - Linux From Scratch r12.3-930-systemd on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB (nvidia; 575.57.08) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.55 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I use Hyprland on Wayland. But the actual problem is WHY it is reloading everything when i switch windows. Yes you read that right. Windows. Even the engine's windows. I mean like switching to another workspace or getting out of the engine windows is fine but trying to reload plugins on the engine's windows is too far from where I draw the line. I have to wait like 10-15 freaking seconds (on HEAVY scenes). Combine with heavy window switching (engine windows included). That wastes like MINUTES off of the work.

### Steps to reproduce

1. install like gdextension plugins (qoiformat for example)
2. install Controller Icons (gdscript edition)
3. make the project heavy
4. now try to open some engine windows and hover over them (ESPECIALLY the attribute (the make unique buttoned one) window)
5. Now if you did that correctly (might need more steps to reproduce, idk.), the window should disappear when you RMB'd something that can be made unique. (e.g materials) Now it will error out (The time can differ but on me it causes a delay bc its recompiling every single plugin for some reason I guess)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Since I can't upload here, I can send the plugin list. (Yes there will be gdextensions too)
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xzsDbDQO4fJOlV1gMjerqMldlmTWO9kV/view?usp=sharing

I think it's more about plugins since it errors out. Footage will be included here:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd7082ac-cf0d-4442-bcd0-836ca4286f39

See the error count go up? Yeah...
enable all plugins except SunshineClouds2, optiscene, Simple Multimesh and Merging Meshes and Plugin Reloader and Discord RPC

Please dont expose me if i included anything personal
